summary: Scroll-to-bottom arrow now only shows on active chat page, not on home/welcome screen
details: Added home-screen visibility check in chat_minimap.js updateScrollTracking(). Arrow button only shows when #home-screen has class 'hidden' (i.e., user is in an active conversation).

summary: Removed Documents section from Library and removed background card box from Media empty state
details: Removed Documents section accordion from images_page.js, and set background: transparent !important and border: none !important on .img-gallery-empty in 8c_image_gallery.css.

summary: Fixed Library empty state cards (Documents & Media) visibility in Light Mode
details: Updated .library-empty-box and .img-gallery-empty in 8c_image_gallery.css by setting background: var(--hover) and border: 1px solid var(--border), ensuring soft grey card container contrast against white background in Light mode.

summary: Added 1px border outline to permission request card and enabled soft line wrapping with height-synced line numbers in Live Canvas
details: Updated permission-request-card in agent_stream.js with border: 1px solid var(--border) and box-shadow. Updated Live Canvas code editor in live_canvas.js and 9_live_canvas.css to set wrap='soft', white-space: pre-wrap, overflow-x: hidden (eliminating horizontal scrollbars), and implemented a hidden DOM mirror height calculation in updateLineNumbers() so line numbers stay 100% synchronized with wrapped lines.
